title: TinyMyo: a Tiny Foundation Model for Flexible EMG Signal Processing at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2512.15729v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Objective: Surface electromyography (EMG) is widely used in biomechanics, rehabilitation, prosthetic control, and human-machine interfaces. Generalization across subjects, recording systems, and acquisition protocols remains challenging. Existing EMG foundation models (FMs) have limited support for multiple downstream tasks and deployment on low-power devices. Methods: We introduce TinyMyo, a 3.6-million-parameter Transformer encoder pre-trained on public EMG datasets using self-supervised masked reconstruction. TinyMyo supports multiple tasks with minimal changes to the task-specific prediction head. Results: We evaluated TinyMyo on hand gesture classification, hand kinematic regression, speech production, and speech recognition. For gesture classification, TinyMyo outperformed previously reported EMG FMs, achieving accuracies of 87.98% on NinaPro DB5, 97.1% on UCI-EMG, and 96.6% on EPN-612. translated_title: TinyMyo：一个用于边缘端灵活肌电信号处理的微型基础模型
translated_abstract: 目标：表面肌电图（EMG）广泛应用于生物力学、康复、假肢控制和人机接口领域，但跨受试者、记录系统和采集协议的泛化仍然具有挑战性。现有的肌电基础模型（FM）对多个下游任务的支持以及低功耗设备上的部署能力有限。方法：我们提出了TinyMyo，一个拥有360万参数的Transformer编码器，通过自监督掩码重建在公开的肌电数据集上进行预训练。TinyMyo只需对任务特定的预测头进行极小改动即可支持多种任务。结果：我们在手势分类、手部运动学回归、语音产生和语音识别上评估了TinyMyo。在手势分类任务中，TinyMyo优于之前报道的肌电基础模型，在NinaPro DB5上达到87.98%的准确率，在UCI-EMG上达到97.1%，在EPN-612上达到96.6%。在GAP9超低功耗微控制器上……
tldr: TinyMyo是一个仅360万参数的微型肌电基础模型，通过自监督掩码重建预训练支持多种下游任务，手势分类性能超越现有肌电基础模型，并可在超低功耗微控制器上实现边缘端部署。
en_tdlr: TinyMyo is a tiny 3.6-million-parameter EMG foundation model that, through self-supervised masked reconstruction pretraining, supports multiple downstream tasks, outperforms previously reported EMG foundation models on gesture classification, and enables deployment on ultra-low-power edge microcontrollers.
